name: Mikel
source: Mikel is one of the three High Council members that serve King Lucius. He is a cunning and intelligent vampire, if not a little overly ambitious. Whilst powerful vampires have no requirement to drink blood regularly, Mikel makes a habit of drinking it multiple times every day.
